text: mode disabling dependent ExecutableEntity A mode disabling dependent RunnableEntity or a Basic Software Schedulable Entity is triggered by an RTEEvent respectively a BswEvent with a ModeDisablingDependency. RTE and Basic Software Scheduler prevent the start of those RunnableEntity or Basic Software Schedulable Entity by the RTEEvent / BswEvent, when the corresponding mode disabling is active. See also section 2.2.

targets.why: Prevent start of runnable when mode disabling active
